description: A precisely minimal modern kitchen in a monochromatic cool grey and white palette. The layout is a galley-with-island configuration viewed from a three-quarter standing perspective. The central island is a long rectangular slab of honed travertine or stone composite — a veined light grey with a matte surface — its waterfall edge descending on the near side, with a seamlessly integrated sink and brushed brass gooseneck faucet along the rear edge. Two low-profile counter-height bar chairs in charcoal grey upholstered fabric with slim matte-black powder-coated sled legs sit at the island's near face. The perimeter cabinetry is handle-free matte white with soft-close slabs in the lower run and warm grey matte-lacquer slab door panels in the upper tall cabinets — one section incorporates open shelving cubbies with internal depth for display. The entire back-splash and hood-surround zone is clad in large-format honed limestone or travertine slabs matching the island top, with a similar grey speckled terrazzo or stone character extending to the ceiling. A substantial integrated ventilation hood in the same stone material acts as a monolithic sculptural element on the back wall. The floor is large-format matte white or pale grey porcelain tile. A single ceramic textured grey vase on the countertop holds a cluster of bare willow or cherry blossom branches. A steel-framed glass partition door is partially visible at the left edge. At the left, a tall floor-to-ceiling steel and reeded-glass partition adds a graphite industrial element. Four warm-directional spots cast focused pools of clean white light downward onto the countertops from above. Camera is at standing eye-level, shooting a wide three-quarter view of the kitchen with the island in the foreground and the run of cabinetry behind. A lighting fixture matching the product reference image is installed naturally within this scene at the appropriate location for the product category. Render the fixture exactly per the reference image — preserve all proportions, materials, finishes, and design details.
